title: The Plasma
body:
![Plasma](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1138ff91a86494bbb1b1a49bb89cbaeeb2f6b714.png)

The Plasma - A mod that will add many things related to a new material better than netherite - Plasma!
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Geckolib is required for this to work!**


# Description:
With this mod, you now have the Plasma material.
There are two ways to obtain Plasma (Plasma Ingot).
### 1.
#### Take a Netherite Ingot, drop it, and wait for lightning to strike it or nearby. Then it will turn into a Plasma Ingot.
### 2.
#### Craft a Thunderer's Table. Go to its menu and place the trident in the trident slot. Place the trident in the second slot. Then press "Charge." The item will be charged, but the trident's durability will be consumed.
---
YOU CANNOT CHARGE WEAPONS OR TOOLS IMMEDIATELY IN ANY WAY!
List of items that can be charged using methods 1 or 2:
Netherite Ingot
Any Netherite Armor (will charge, but not completely)
Blaze Rod
To obtain working Plasma Armor, you need to:
Charge it using any method
then combine the half-charged armor with 3 Plasma Ingots.
Tools are crafted like regular ones, but with Plasma Rods instead of sticks and Plasma as the material.
Plasma has the properties of lightning—that's its advantage.
There's also Ectoplasm, which has a chance to drop from lightning strikes or when using a Thunderer's Table. It can be made into a soup that, when consumed, strikes mobs within a 6-block radius with lightning. If there are no mobs, it can strike any nearby chargeable item, otherwise it'll just go nowhere.
Also, if you place a plasma core block and surround it with 6 plasma blocks, a Plasma Golem will appear, which behaves similarly to an iron one, but is stronger.

Version 1.0.5 introduced a new item: the Plasma Dagger. When hitting an entity, it teleports the player to its coordinates, and the entity to the player's coordinates, swapping them. On a critical hit, it teleports the player a little further away and the mob to the player's position.

However, the Plasma Dagger does not have lightning properties.

The new versions also have a couple of new blocks such as: Plasma Drawer, which allows you to store a lot of things and is solid and explosion-proof, and Plasma Lantern - a bright lamp and also solid and explosion-proof.

There is also a Plasma Haste effect - during it, if the player is struck by lightning, he will receive level 3 haste for a while.

Ectoplasm can be used to brew a Lightning potion (but it can also be obtained with a full armor set).

In new versions, a Plasma Apple will appear that gives buffs when converging.



Version 1.0.4.5 introduced Plasma Nuggets, 9 of which can be crafted into 1 ingot, and 1 ingot into 9 nuggets.
8 plasma nuggets and 1 emerald in the center can be crafted into a music disk.

The mod also includes its own weapon, the Plasma Hammer. It works like the others, striking with a hammer and having a longer cooldown, but it also explodes the target on impact. It has a slower attack speed.

You can also create a Plasma Pulsar from Gold, Echo Shards, and an Ectoplasm Artifact in the center. It can be used to knock back and damage nearby creatures!



Plasma tools and weapons strike the target with lightning on impact with a cooldown.

There's also the lightning effect, and if you have it and get struck by lightning, it will make you stronger!

With a full set of plasma armor, the player will receive a lightning effect.

Ectoplasm can be obtained from the Thunderer's table or if lightning strikes somewhere with some chance!

In version 1.0.2 and higher, a profession for the villager is available - Thunderer on the Thunderer's table.



The mod also includes item Plasma Throwing dynamite (not a block) , which can be thrown and when it hits a block, it will explode and cause lightning. There is also a Plasma TNT block, which, when ignited, like regular TNT, will flash and emit smoke and then explode along with lightning. It has an animation of the explosion starting after being set on fire.



In the new versions of the mod, there will be a companion called Bob. Make it from a plasma apple, and this creature will talk to you whenever you want! Just right-click on it. Bob, although an alive object, looks like a plasma apple with eyes and a smile.

Plasma can easily be used for a beacon.



### In version 1.0.5, a small amount of content not related to plasma will be provided.

 ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 
### This mod is still in development, so errors are possible.
### Russian, Italian and English languages ​​are supported.
